warmup: The left baseline retains one prepared checkpoint/workspace per case for the entire trial. Each right process warms each case once. Retain up to two loaded models. Run a single command at a time and alternate the first arm within each case. Reverse the phase order on the experimental partner. Prefill starts from fresh KV; decode restores the cached position with private suffix pages.
interpretation: Follow-up diagnostic on a real checkpoint. Preserve the previous synthetic hold even if this screen is favorable. Require exact outputs, KV, positions and workspace, stable same-binary controls in both groups per phase, and all memory bounds. To count as a positive live signal both two-session prefixes must meet the speed bound and wins, and each arm-order median must be < 1. Other stages must meet no-regression limits. No default adoption from this alone.
